summary: First-iteration e2e testing of DC Valeting landing page. All backend endpoints (root, POST/GET bookings, 404, 422 validation) pass. Frontend renders correctly on desktop (1600x1000): TopBar/Navbar/Hero headline 'PROFESSIONAL CARE. PREMIUM RESULTS.', inline booking panel visible. Full 4-step booking flow (Service -> Date & Time -> Details -> Confirm) successfully submits to /api/bookings and shows 'BOOKING CONFIRMED' state. Packages (STAGE 1 & STAGE 2), Gallery (8 images), Footer contact info (07949 123 456, dcvaleting@outlook.com, 2025 copyright) all verified.

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of 201 Created on successful creation (FastAPI default). Minor REST convention issue.

action_items: Optional: change POST /api/bookings to return 201 Created instead of 200 to follow REST conventions (low priority).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: POST /api/bookings should ideally return HTTP 201 with status_code=201 in the route decorator.
BookingPanel.jsx: 'phone' field has no client-side regex validation; backend also accepts any string. Consider Pydantic constr/regex for phone format.

BookingPanel.jsx: date.toISOString().slice(0,10) uses UTC; user in a positive timezone selecting a late-evening local date may submit the next-day in UTC. Use a local-date formatter (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD from getFullYear/Month/Date) to avoid off-by-one.
Hero.jsx: BookingPanel inside Hero is also used as the booking entry point when navbar BOOK NOW is clicked; ensure smooth scroll/focus target is set (currently relies on layout proximity).
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan context.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed bookings via API and UI (test_john@example.com, test_playwright@example.com). Safe to leave; can be cleaned via Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_bookings.py - run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend booking panel is rendered inline inside Hero on lg breakpoint (>=1024px). Use viewport >=1440 for full layout. Test ids verified: navbar-book-now, hero-book-cta, booking-panel, booking-service, booking-size-{small|suv|xl}, booking-time-HH:MM, booking-name/email/phone/address/notes, booking-continue, booking-back, booking-confirm, booking-new. Calendar day buttons selectable via 'button[name=day]:not([disabled])'.
